A1.justification: Both PDFs describe GP-4DGS and contain 14 readable pages, including Appendices A–E. Their text, equations, tables, and rendered figures support a reliable full comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original reconstruction, motion-extrapolation, and uncertainty-evaluation results in Section 5, plus optimization/kernel ablations and per-scene results in appendix Tables B–D.

after.justification: v2 retains the original empirical results in Section 5 and appendix Tables B–D, including reconstruction comparisons, extrapolation experiments, and ablations.

M1.justification: Sections 4.1–4.5 and Algorithm 1 retain identical GP deformation models, spatial-temporal kernels, inducing-point inference, GP-GS optimization, and prediction procedures.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same DyCheck scenes and subsets, DAVIS examples, and reconstruction, motion-extrapolation, and uncertainty-evaluation tasks. No dataset or test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in every corresponding experiment, including Gaussian Marbles and SoM for reconstruction, linear extrapolation for forecasting, and Random and UA-4DGS for uncertainty evaluation.

E3.justification: The same masked reconstruction metrics, five- and fifteen-frame extrapolation holdouts, and top-20/top-40/all-frame AUSE evaluations are retained. Experimental settings in Section 5 and Appendix D are identical.

E4.justification: The inducing-point initialization comparison, GP-GS optimization ablation, periodic-component and kernel analyses, extreme-viewpoint tests, and trajectory visualizations are unchanged, including all appendix analyses.

E5.justification: Uncertainty estimation and reporting are identical, including Monte Carlo motion uncertainty in Section 4.4 and Table 3. There are no changes to run-count, seed, confidence-interval, or significance-test reporting.

E6.justification: All numerical entries in Tables 1–4 and appendix Tables A–D, and all qualitative results, are unchanged. For example, Table 1 retains GP-4DGS's all-scene DyCheck scores of 17.38 mPSNR, 0.65 mSSIM, and 0.37 mLPIPS.

T1.justification: Equations (1)–(21) and appendix equations (A)–(G) are identical, including the GP posterior, variational objective, and periodic mean/kernel definitions. No mathematical reasoning or assumptions are revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain identical claims about uncertainty quantification, motion priors for poorly observed regions, temporal extrapolation, and improved reconstruction.

C2.justification: Interpretations and applicability qualifications are unchanged, including the explanation of GP-guided motion regularization and Appendix B's warning that periodic means introduce spurious oscillations in non-periodic motion.

D1.justification: Implementation and reproducibility information is identical, including GPyTorch, learning rates, kernel length scales, batch size, and GP optimization iterations. No technical or resource-access information is added.

R1.justification: All 55 reference entries and the related-work discussion are identical. The new personal acknowledgement does not change cited research or contribution positioning.

P1.justification: v2 adds a sentence thanking Eduardo Pérez-Pellitero of Huawei Noah’s Ark Lab for discussions and support, and updates the arXiv version/date stamp. All other prose and section organization are unchanged.

P2.justification: The added acknowledgement causes bibliography entries to reflow across columns and pages 9–10. Scientific figures, tables, captions, and appendix layouts remain identical.

improvement.justification: v2 adds personal credit and updates the version stamp, with minor bibliography reflow. The scientific text, experimental evidence, mathematical content, and appendices are unchanged, establishing no meaningful net difference in overall paper quality.
